purpose: Strict machine-readable contract for selecting one primary system and at most one reserve system for a Second Shift night from fresh current authority.
eligibility_rule: eligible=true if and only if every eligibility check is true. Ineligible candidates require one or more factual rejection reasons and cannot be selected regardless of score.

score_policy.component_rule: Each component is an integer from 0 through its maximum. total_score must equal the exact sum of components. Scores require evidence/rationale; importance alone cannot bypass eligibility.
tie_breakers: older last_primary_night_at; null means never selected and is oldest

primary_rule: When one or more candidates are eligible, selected_primary_system must equal the first candidate in the deterministic ranking and status must be FROZEN. Top-level system WIP is one.
reserve_rule: selected_reserve_system is null when fewer than two candidates are eligible; otherwise it must be the second candidate in deterministic ranking. It is non-executable until Assignment Contract v3 reserve activation law is satisfied.
no_eligible_rule: When no candidate is eligible, status=NO_ELIGIBLE_SYSTEM, ranking is empty, selected_primary_system and selected_reserve_system are null, and no overnight product mutation is admitted.
invariants: Candidate control_head values are exact hexadecimal Git object ids.
Eligible candidates have a non-empty executable queue and score evidence.
Ineligible candidates cannot appear in ranking.
Ranking contains every eligible candidate exactly once and in deterministic policy order.
Primary and reserve can never be the same system.
Round-robin position alone is never a selection rule.
Fresh authority and eligibility are gates, not score components that can be traded away.
This schema selects work but grants no product, A-01, human, author, private, native, publication or production authority.
